latest.notes:
Fixes the Song Airplay report and the song that kept turning up at :58.

• Song Airplay listed elements that never actually aired — a song cut off at the top of the hour left a timestamp in the report as though a listener had heard it. The report now lists real airings only, and one that was cut short shows how much of it went out.
• The top-of-hour filler kept reaching for the same record. When the gap is too small for any song to fit, it was picking purely by which song would be trimmed least — which is the shortest song in the rotation, every hour. It now treats close overshoots as equally good and takes the one that has rested longest. Separation still comes first.

A fill rotation used to plug a two-minute hole will always lean on its shorter songs; adding a few more short-to-mid-length records to it spreads the load further.
